findings.current: Taishan, who was not as strong as I was but was a natural strongman—and was even bigger than me—could manage as many as three.
findings.defect: The draft adds a direct size comparison with Taekyung. The source says Taishan has a large build, not that he is bigger than Taekyung.
findings.rationale: 덩치까지 큰 characterizes Taishan as large; it does not contain the comparative meaning “bigger than me.”
findings.replacement: Taishan, who was not as strong as I was but was a natural strongman with a massive build, could manage as many as three.
findings.source: 나보다는 못하지만 타고난 역사(力士)인 데다 덩치까지 큰 태산은 세 마리까지 감당할 수 있었다.

findings.current: For several days, we climbed mountains while carrying horses, dug through buried roads, and walked and ran without stopping.
findings.defect: The draft adds that the party traveled without stopping for several days.
findings.rationale: The source lists what they did over several days but does not say that they took no breaks.
findings.replacement: For several days, we carried horses up mountains, dug through buried roads, and alternated between walking and running.
findings.source: 말을 짊어진 채 산을 오르고, 매몰된 길을 파헤치며 걷고 또 달리기를 며칠.

findings.current: All of it was thanks to Ju Hwaran, who knew the shortcuts shared only among a handful of old horse caravans and remembered all the information left behind by her grandfather, the Escort King.
findings.defect: The draft omits the specified maternal relationship.
findings.rationale: 외조부 specifically means maternal grandfather, not the relationship-neutral “grandfather.”
findings.replacement: All of it was thanks to Ju Hwaran, who knew the shortcuts shared only among a handful of old horse caravans and remembered all the information left behind by her maternal grandfather, the Escort King.
findings.source: 이 모든 것이 소수의 옛 마방들만이 공유하던 지름길, 그리고 표왕(漂王)이라 불리던 외조부가 남긴 자료를 모두 기억하고 있던 주화란 덕분이었다.

findings.current: I saw you. Don’t pretend you weren’t doing anything.
findings.defect: The draft changes what Song Ilseom is pretending: the source says he is pretending not to know what Taekyung means, not pretending that he was doing nothing.
findings.rationale: 모른 척 means feigning ignorance, while 다 봤어 means Taekyung saw the whole reaction.
findings.replacement: I saw everything. Don’t pretend you don’t know what I mean.

findings.current: What happened earlier. You seemed not to have heard my answer.
findings.defect: The draft reverses the subject and action, claiming Taekyung failed to hear an answer when Song Ilseom is saying that he himself had not answered.
findings.rationale: 대답을 안 한 것 같아서 refers to Song Ilseom apparently not having given an answer, which is why he now resumes the earlier exchange.
findings.replacement: What happened a moment ago. I realized I never answered you.
findings.source: 조금 전에 있었던 일 말이다. 대답을 안 한 것 같아서.

findings.current: Assuming television had been introduced, it might even reach a ninety-seven percent viewership rating—like the turnout in a Russian presidential election.
findings.defect: The draft changes 107 percent to ninety-seven percent, removing the deliberately impossible quantity that drives the joke.
findings.rationale: The source explicitly gives 107%, using an impossible percentage as the punchline.
findings.replacement: Assuming television had been introduced, it might even reach a 107 percent viewership rating—like the turnout in a Russian presidential election.
findings.source: TV가 보급되었다는 전제하라면 러시아 대선 투표율처럼 시청률 107% 정도 찍을지도 모르겠다.

findings.current: By then, more than a dozen swift ships had emerged through the fog, with the flags of the Water Dragon Stronghold fluttering above them.
findings.defect: The draft increases the stated number of ships from roughly ten to more than twelve.
findings.rationale: 십여 척 means approximately ten or a dozen or so, whereas “more than a dozen” establishes a higher minimum.
findings.replacement: By then, a dozen or so swift ships had emerged through the fog, with the flags of the Water Dragon Stronghold fluttering above them.
findings.source: 어느덧 안개를 해치며 나타난 십여 척의 쾌조선(快調船)과 그 위에 나부끼는 수룡채의 깃발을 확인한 내가 중얼거렸다.

summary: The draft contains several actionable fidelity errors involving kinship, added physical comparisons and actions, a reversed subject, and altered quantities.
